implementation_steps.description: This plan document — read-only planner output

Add 6 new fixture generators: create_angular_fixture_180x, create_passable_fixture, create_compiler_error_fixture, create_dependency_conflict_fixture, create_environment_blocker_fixture, create_cancellable_fixture. All accept (root: Path, name: str) -> Path signature. Each creates deterministic Angular workspace with package.json, angular.json, tsconfig.json, and one or more .ts source files. Compiler-error fixture includes intentional syntax error in main.ts. Dependency-conflict fixture publishes incompatible @angular/core/rxjs versions. Environment-blocker fixture adds a pre-check script that fails. Cancellable fixture adds an infinite setTimeout loop.

Add HarnessFixtureType enum (ANGULAR_180X, ANGULAR_182X, PASSABLE, COMPILER_ERROR, DEPENDENCY_CONFLICT, ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKER, CANCELLABLE). Add HarnessFixtureConfig DTO (fixture_type, name, root_dir path). Add HarnessRequestDto (fixture_type, idempotency_key, expected_state_version, actor). Add HarnessResultDto (fixture_id, fixture_root, outcome, evidence_refs, state_version, idempotent_replay). Add HarnessStatusDto (overall_status, fixtures list, errors list, evidence summary). All frozen, extra='forbid', Pydantic v2.

Create harness subprocess profile definitions. Define HARNESS_COMMAND_REGISTRY extending CommandRegistry with: ng-new (ng new), ng-generate (ng generate), ng-build (ng build), npm-install (npm install), npx-ng-update (npx ng update). Define HARNESS_PROFILE_ID='harness-runtime-profile'. Define harness workspace directory aliases (HARNESS_FIXTURE_ROOT, HARNESS_OUTPUT_ROOT). Reuse existing CommandPolicy, ExecutionWorker, and WorkerSupervisor patterns.

Create RuntimeEvidenceCollector service. Methods: record_fixture_manifest(fixture_type, root, checksum) -> ArtifactRefDto; record_isolation_evidence(fixture_root, output_root) -> ArtifactRefDto; record_output_layout_evidence(layout) -> ArtifactRefDto; record_integration_result(result, duration) -> ArtifactRefDto; record_proof_report(summary) -> ArtifactRefDto. Each method writes through LocalFilesystemArtifactStore with atomic write, SHA-256 checksum, and ArtifactMetadataModel registration. Reuses the _write_evidence pattern from MigrationRunService.

Create AcceptanceHarnessService. Constructor accepts settings, session_scope_factory, artifact_store, evidence_collector, execution_worker, now_provider. Methods: generate_fixture(request) -> HarnessResultDto — selects generator from fixture type, creates workspace under external temp root, writes fixture manifest evidence; run_subprocess_profile(request) -> CommandExecutionResult — configures harness CommandRegistry, resolves working directory, delegates to ExecutionWorker; evaluate_fixture(fixture_id, profile_id) -> HarnessResultDto — runs ng build, checks exit code, records pass/fail evidence; run_acceptance_suite(requests) -> HarnessStatusDto — orchestrates full fixture → subprocess → collection → evaluation cycle. Implements idempotency via StateTransitionService. Implements stale-state detection via expected_state_version. Returns typed HarnessResultDto with evidence ArifactRefDto list. Does NOT duplicate G01–G09 logic.

Create APIRouter with prefix='/api/v1/operator/acceptance-suite', tags=['acceptance']. Route: GET /status -> returns HarnessStatusDto (overall status from AcceptanceHarnessService). Route: POST /fixtures -> returns HarnessResultDto (generate + run fixture). Route: POST /fixtures/evaluate -> returns HarnessResultDto (evaluate specific fixture). All routes use Depends(get_harness_service) for dependency injection. Error handling via error_response(). SSE not required for phase A (acceptance-suite events are optional per S4-F15).

Import acceptance_router from app.api.routes.acceptance. Add api_router.include_router(acceptance_router) and api_v1_router.include_router(acceptance_router) to register the acceptance endpoints. Must declare as shared file edit per OWNERSHIP.yaml rules.

Extend existing test file with parametrized tests for each new fixture generator variant. Test: files exist (package.json, angular.json, tsconfig.json, main.ts). Test: compiler-error fixture fails TypeScript compilation (subprocess check). Test: dependency-conflict fixture has incompatible peer dependencies. Test: environment-blocker fixture returns non-zero from pre-check. Test: cancellable fixture has blocking operation. Test: all fixtures are created under external tmp_path root.

Create comprehensive test file. Test groups: (A) AcceptanceHarnessService — happy path: generate_fixture returns HarnessResultDto with valid fixture_root; invalid input: unknown fixture type raises error; idempotent: same request returns same result; stale state: wrong expected_state_version fails. (B) RuntimeEvidenceCollector — each record method returns ArtifactRefDto with checksum; write is atomic; metadata is findable by artifact_id. (C) Harness subprocess profiles — ExecutionWorker configured with harness registry executes ng commands when ng CLI is available; throws CommandPolicyViolation for unregistered commands. (D) Fixture evaluation — passable fixture passes ng build; compiler-error fixture fails ng build. (E) Fake model integration — MockLlmGateway + mock agents invoked through harness returns deterministic outputs. Uses tmp_path isolation, inline SQLite, RecordingGraph-style DI.

Create fake model integration suite. Test: MockLlmGateway.complete returns deterministic mock response. Test: mock agents return AgentOutputEnvelope with correct agent_name. Test: harness service can sequence: generate fixture → pass to fake agents → collect evidence. Test: usage records are created with correct token counts. Test: budget decisions work within constraints. Reuses MockLlmGateway, MOCK_AGENTS directly. Each test runs against fresh state.

Add test_openapi_publishes_harness_contracts — asserts new HarnessFixtureType, HarnessRequestDto, HarnessResultDto, HarnessStatusDto appear in OpenAPI schema. Add test_harness_dto_rejects_unknown_fields — Pydantic extra='forbid' enforcement. Add test_harness_dto_frozen — model_dump then mutation raises TypeError.

Security and negative test section. Tests: path escape in fixture root — fixture_root='../outside' raises ArtifactStoreError; checksum mismatch — tampered artifact content triggers checksum verification failure; unauthorized input — missing idempotency_key rejected; stale state version — expected_state_version mismatch returns stable error; policy bypass — unregistered command executable rejected by CommandPolicy.

risks.description: Fixture not representative — synthetic Angular workspaces may not trigger real-world migration edge cases or failure modes
risks.mitigation: Deterministic failure fixtures replicate known failure patterns (compiler errors, dep conflicts, env blockers). Phase B replaces with real-application fixtures.

risks.description: Subprocess timing — npm install, ng build may be slow or time-dependent in test environments
risks.mitigation: Generous timeouts (120s for npm install, 60s for ng build). Cancellable fixtures use deterministic timeouts. Tests fall back to SKIPPED markers when CLI unavailable.

risks.description: Environment dependency — some failure fixtures rely on specific tool versions (Node 18+, npm 9+, Angular CLI)
risks.mitigation: Harness profiles detect runtime availability via existing CommandRegistry version checks. Missing tools produce deterministic BLOCKED outcomes, not flaky failures.

risks.description: Phase A boundary violation — risk of inadvertently implementing G01–G09 production services in harness code
risks.mitigation: AcceptanceHarnessService explicitly delegates to StateTransitionService for state changes (never duplicates). Uses fake adapters exclusively. No command execution policy that replicates G01–G09 logic. BLOCKED_INTEGRATION criteria strictly enforced.

risks.description: Shared file conflicts — router.py and contracts.py are shared files requiring declaration before editing per OWNERSHIP.yaml
risks.mitigation: Declare shared edits explicitly in task result. Use minimal additions (one import + include_router line in router.py, one enum + three DTOs in contracts.py).

risks.description: Cancellable operations need reliable process-tree termination across platforms
risks.mitigation: Reuse existing WorkerSupervisor.terminate_process_tree which handles SIGTERM/SIGKILL on POSIX and CTRL_BREAK_EVENT on Windows. Cancellable fixture sets cancel_event thread signal.

risks.description: Evidence checksum integrity — must maintain SHA-256 immutability across all harness evidence artifacts
risks.mitigation: RuntimeEvidenceCollector delegates to LocalFilesystemArtifactStore which enforces atomic write + SHA-256. Testing verifies checksums match after readback.

risks.description: Cross-goal frozen schemas — harness evidence types must conform to 26 consumed schemas
risks.mitigation: Evidence written as artifact_ref.schema.json compatible ArtifactRefDto. No new frozen schemas introduced by Phase A.

risks.description: Runtime duration — end-to-end harness test with real subprocesses may exceed test timeouts
risks.mitigation: Unit tests use fake subprocess profiles (mock ExecutionWorker). Real subprocess tests gated behind pytest.mark.slow. CI runs unit tests only; manual run triggers slow tests.
